reviews.title: Good when it works…
reviews.text: The concept of the app is great, unfortunately the app itself is shockingly unreliable. We’ve had the premium tier for almost a month now and have had to remove and reinstall, from both children’s devices weekly. It is VERY buggy and frequently doesn’t allocate additional time remotely or directly in the device. It sends unsafe text alerts that are often incorrect. It has removed location sharing from both parent and child devices multiple times so has to be reconnected. It needs a tonne of dev work and until that’s done the app won’t be fit for purpose. I wish we hadn’t wasted money paying for the annual subscription as it’s not worth the cost considering how unreliable it it.

reviews.title: So many issues
reviews.text:
I have used this app for almost a year now. It’s not perfect, but it was working well for a while. However, there was an update about a month ago that has made this app essentially useless and a huge headache. The time limit settings are just not working consistently at all. The internet connectivity is inconsistent and often doesn’t work. Multiple times a day I have to turn off the VPN setting and connect their device to the internet before the VPN turns back on. This is incredibly inconvenient. This connectivity issue is also why the time limits aren’t working consistently. I’ve asked for assistance multiple times with no success. Then was told there would be a fix and new update. Waited several days with nothing. Then when I asked about it they said “oh the update didn’t fix the problem, there’s no fix.” 

I’m about to delete the app, ask for a prorated refund, and find an alternative.

reviews.title: My honest review
reviews.text: So I gave this app 2 stars because I think it can be helpful for parents sometimes. However, for children, not so much. I once got called down stairs because it had looked through my camera roll and detected n*dity, it was literally the flower boy album cover (it’s Tyler with a bee covering his face in a field of flowers and wasps for those who don’t know) and I was really scared, the amount of anxiety I get every time I misclick onto something in*ppr*priat or type something that could be misinterpreted as something rude gives me so much anxiety, I do recommend talking to your parents about it though. I don’t have Kidslox anymore as I was showing my mum a pic on my phone and it said my phone was in the ocean (we were in my house) and other stuff that made it seem unreliable, but yeah, if your a child reading this, you do need parental controls, but not so many that you feel uncomfortable, and if your a parent, please don’t be harsh with your child’s device, the reason they have a phone/tablet etc is because you trust them with it, so there’s no point monitoring their every move, and if your child is stressed or going through p*berty, please don’t worry them even more by adding all these extra controls and limits, it just a lot. Okay byeee
